value.rationale: The minimal polynomial degree permitting an off-essential spectral island is a natural quantitative test bed: normalized isolation distance provides the sharp geometric separation radius (not a resolvent estimate), while the eigenvector norm under intrinsic origin-value normalization \(u(0)=1\) measures geometric concentration. The complete sharp 1/48 bound and equal linear gap slopes paired with logarithmic versus inverse-square eigenvector blowup expose two different spectral-collision mechanisms. These exact invariants can inform perturbative spectral and eigenmode studies; neither the mere n=2 determinant substitution nor correctness/reproducibility alone is used to justify value.
